side_a: CC 5.1: Turning kept on mid-stream wraps the current and later epochs.
side_b: CC 5.3.3.2.5: A publisher changes keep mid-stream at an epoch boundary, as ruled for one DEK per stream per epoch, and the change reaches forward only.
note: 5.1 wraps the epoch in progress at the moment keep is turned on; 5.3.3.2.5 lets the change take effect only at an epoch boundary. On a call with no membership change the boundary may never come, so one build keeps the current epoch and the other keeps nothing until the next commit. 5.1 is the home and is specific (on: current and later; off: from the next epoch).
